bench.title: Benchmark
bench.waiting: Waiting for the network to send your benchmark. Keep Vouch Compute open and plugged in.
bench.progress: {ratio, number, percent} · {rounds, plural, one {# round} other {# rounds}} done. If you start using the computer, it stops, even if you chose “Run now”.
bench.finished: Benchmark finished. Results are checked by the server.
bench.stopped: The benchmark stopped before it finished. It will start again later.
bench.about: A signed speed test runs at full speed for about 20 minutes. It stops if you use the computer, if the computer gets too hot or if it switches to battery. Your “Power use” setting applies to paid work, not to this test. The test is never paid, and you can stop it at any time.

perf.title: Performance
perf.sub: How fast this computer ran its benchmark, and where it stands on the server.
perf.tokenHint: Tokens are the small pieces of text an AI model reads. More tokens per second means a faster computer.
perf.empty: This computer's speed appears here after its first benchmark.
perf.measuredHere: Measured by the app on this computer.
perf.note: The app measures this speed on this computer for your information. The server measures the benchmark itself, and only verified work is paid.

earnings.title: Earnings

earnings.statusSub: Only verified work is counted. New earnings are held before they are paid.
earnings.unavailable: Earnings are available once you're signed in and online. ({error})
earnings.splitLabel: How your earnings split by status
earnings.empty: Nothing earned yet. Verified work shows up here a day after it is done.
earnings.probation: New device: earnings are held for {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} while work is verified.
earnings.probationUntil: New device: earnings are held for {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} while work is verified (until {date}).

payout.title: Payout account

payout.unavailable: Payout account details are available once you're signed in.

payout.fine: For your safety, payout accounts are set up and changed only on the web, with your second factor. Any change pauses payouts for 72 hours. Verify your identity on the web to get paid.

limits.title: Limits
limits.sub: Vouch Compute pauses before this computer gets too hot, and you choose how hard it works.
limits.tempMax: Vouch Compute never exceeds 90 °C, whatever this is set to.

battery.title: Never run on battery
battery.hint: Below 30% battery it never runs, regardless.

account.title: This device on your account
account.fine: Pausing here works like pausing on the web: no new work arrives until you resume. A running job finishes and is paid if it verifies.

reliability.title: Reliability
reliability.empty: Your reliability tier appears here once the server has one for this device.
reliability.about: Tiers are decided by the server from how reliably the device is available and finishes work, and change at most once a day.

hint.keepRegularHours: Keep regular hours: be available at similar times each week.
hint.avoidDisconnects: Avoid disconnects: a steady connection helps.
hint.finishAcceptedJobs: Finish the jobs you accept: avoid stopping work midway, for example by setting idle and schedule limits that fit your use.
hint.buildTenure: Keep going: reliability builds up over weeks.
hint.verifyIdentity: Verify your identity on the web.
hint.useHardwareKey: Use a computer with a hardware security chip (TPM).

welcome.title: Welcome to Vouch Compute
welcome.lede: Vouch Compute uses your computer's spare time for small, verified AI jobs and pays you for the work that checks out. Please read this first.
welcome.scrollHint: Scroll to the end to continue.

items.sandbox: What runs. Speech-to-text and text embeddings of non-sensitive data, inside a sandbox that has no network access and cannot see your files.
items.inputs: Your computer can technically see job inputs while it processes them. Inputs are kept in memory only and are never saved to disk.
items.electricity: Electricity. Work uses power. Your estimate subtracts an electricity cost so you can judge whether it is worth it.
items.provider: Your internet provider may restrict commercial use of a home connection. Check your contract.
items.taxes: Taxes on what you earn are your responsibility.
items.dollars: Paid in US dollars. Only the AI jobs described here run on your computer. Earnings are paid in US dollars to your payout account (bank or e-wallet).
items.probation: New devices start on probation. Earnings are held in escrow for 21 days while work is verified. Unverified work is not paid.
items.defaults: Defaults are conservative: work starts only when you've been away for 10 minutes, stops the moment you're back, pauses for games and on battery, and respects a temperature limit.

signin.lede: Use your Vouch Compute account. Sign-in happens in your browser with your username, password and second factor, so this window never sees your password or codes.
signin.doneLede: Next, this computer gets its own key.
signin.pendingLede: Open the sign-in page, sign in with your username, password and second factor, then check that this code matches:
signin.readOnly: The app only gets read access to your earnings and devices. Payout account changes always happen on the web.
signin.terms: By signing in and running the app on this computer, you agree to:

signInFirst.title: Sign in first
signInFirst.lede: This computer is registered to your account, so sign in before setting it up.

replace.new: No, this is a new computer

done.title: You're set

done.infoOnly: For your information only. What you can earn is decided by a benchmark, never by what the app reports.
done.summary: Starts after {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}} away and pauses above {temp, number} °C. You can change this any time in Settings.
done.summaryBattery: Starts after {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}} away, pauses above {temp, number} °C and never runs on battery. You can change this any time in Settings.

notices.reverify: Please verify your identity again on the web.

today.noLimit: No daily limit. <link>Set one in Settings</link>

hardware.title: Hardware
hardware.sub: What this computer reports. Pay is set by the benchmark, not by this list.

estimate.title: Estimated range per month
estimate.note: after electricity. An estimate, not a promise.
estimate.noteBonus: after electricity, including a temporary launch bonus. An estimate, not a promise.

controls.none: Controls appear once the agent is running.

idleOnly.title: When I'm away (recommended)
idleOnly.hint: Starts after you've been idle, stops within seconds when you're back.

scheduled.title: On a schedule
scheduled.hint: Only in the hours you pick below.

alwaysOn.title: Always on
alwaysOn.hint: Desktops only. Your computer will feel slower while it works.

controls.scheduleSub: Used in “On a schedule” mode. Times are local; a window can run past midnight.

autostart.title: Start Vouch Compute when I sign in to this computer
autostart.hint: It opens in the tray (the icon next to the clock), not as a window, and follows your limits. You can turn this off here or in your system's startup settings.
autostart.on: Vouch Compute will start when you sign in
autostart.off: Vouch Compute will not start by itself

settings.title: Settings
settings.lede: How and when Vouch Compute works on this computer.

language.title: Language
language.sub: The language of this app. It changes right away.
language.label: App language

theme.title: Appearance
theme.sub: Follows your system unless you pick a theme.

privacy.title: Data and privacy
privacy.sandbox: Jobs run in a sandbox with no network access and no access to your files. Inputs stay in memory and are never written to disk.
privacy.inputs: Only non-sensitive data is processed. Your computer can technically see job inputs while it works on them.
privacy.readOnly: This app gets read-only access to your earnings and devices. Payout account changes happen only on the web.
privacy.counted: Work is counted by the server, never from what this app reports. Only verified work is paid.

recover.title: Recover my account
recover.hint: Only if you started an account recovery on the web and it asks for a code from this app.

repair.text: Creates a new key for this computer, vouched for by the current one, and keeps its tier. Use it only if support asks you to.

about.title: Updates and about
about.sub: Updates are signed; Vouch Compute refuses any update whose signature doesn't verify.

remove.title: Remove this device
remove.text: Removes this computer from your account and deletes its key. Earnings stay with your account. This can't be undone; registering again makes it a new device.

legal.linkAccept: By continuing, you link this computer to your Vouch Compute account and agree to:
legal.englishBinding: These agreements are available in English. The English text is the binding version.
